title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.81 (versions follow prime numbers; 181 after 179): what she finds, in white, and what every part of her thought is. When her forms find something (a new recipe takes the place of an old one: the reason 'replaced' in their archive), that line of the green rain on Luma's panel is drawn white, as the leading sign of each stream of the rain in the film The Matrix. The release notes explain her window part by part: her eight forms and her creatures; the panel's content and her mind; every field of a line of her forms' archive (round, room, the recipe that lost and the one it lost to, the reason, the total worth of her eight forms with the tried recipe and without it, the jump's radius); every reason of the judge (a form's worth is its compression, cells drawn per bit of its recipe, times its novelty, how much of its drawing it does not share; a recipe wins only if the total rises); and where each of her thoughts in words comes from. Correction of 1.79: its two large numbers were said to be totals in bits; they are the total worth of her eight forms. Measured: 'replaced' stands at 13,319 in about 8.2 million trials and has not moved for the whole session, so today her forms find nothing new and the white will show only when they do. Stated limits: her thoughts that find something (a line of her heart's question, a reading record, a walk that came back) stay bright green; during the tests the live Luma was born once with a test build and showed '00'. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.81: lo que sus formas encuentran se pinta de blanco, y su ventana queda explicada parte por parte. Prototipo de investigación.
